Subject: Trellis SIG kickoff — intake agenda & proposed times

Hi Natalie,

Thanks for agreeing to run through Trellis' SIG/CAIQ intake with us. I attached an editable SIG questionnaire and our intake runbook to speed the kickoff. Can we schedule a 30-minute kickoff this week to:

- Confirm scope (environments, regions, data flows)
- Clarify evidence owners and log/sample access windows
- Agree on next steps and attachment handoff cadence

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue 3/16 10:00–10:30
- Wed 3/17 14:00–14:30
- Thu 3/18 09:00–09:30

If those don't work, tell me preferred slots and timezone. A couple quick prep questions so we have the right folks on the call:
1) Do you expect Trellis to provide log extracts (S3 link) or grant us read-only access to a logging bucket?
2) Is Trellis operating in a VPC with egress rules we should be aware of?
3) Any special data handling (PII/PHI) we should mark on the questionnaire?

I'll loop in our compliance engineer and evidence coordinator once we lock time.

Attachments: Trellis_SIG_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), redwood-intake-runbook.pdf (application/pdf)
